findings.title: Existing realms do not receive the new Clients schema
findings.body: Adding Clients to the schema map does not update an already initialized authorization server: `init()` returns early when the realm already has an admin-permissions client. Upgraded realms therefore keep the old scopes and lack the Clients resource-type resource, so client permission checks cannot evaluate the new schema and may fail when looking up that resource. Reconcile the schema for existing clients instead of only seeding it when the client is first created.

findings.title: Role-mapping checks omit the MANAGE_CLIENTS bypass
findings.body: These V2 overrides check only the new per-client FGAP scopes. A caller with the standard `MANAGE_CLIENTS` admin role can pass `canManage(client)` but still fail `canMapRoles`, `canMapCompositeRoles`, and `canMapClientScopeRoles` unless separately granted each scope. This removes the role’s existing ability to manage client roles when V2 is enabled; preserve the global admin-role authorization in these checks.

findings.title: Client-permission lookup does not return individual clients
findings.body: This query searches resources by type, but the schema marks the all-clients resource as type `Clients` while `AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource()` creates individual client resources without setting that type. Consequently, client-specific grants are not found here; an all-clients grant instead returns the sentinel resource name `Clients` rather than client IDs. Callers of `getClientsWithPermission` therefore receive an incorrect set.

findings.title: Token-exchange checks throw when V2 is enabled
findings.body: `AdminPermissions.evaluator()` selects this V2 evaluator whenever the V2 feature is enabled, but `canExchangeTo` throws `UnsupportedOperationException`. A token-exchange authorization path that consults this evaluator will therefore fail with an unhandled exception instead of making an authorization decision, breaking token-exchange requests. Implement the V2 behavior or fail closed with a handled authorization denial.
